title: Tree-Based Formalization of Multi-Agent Complementarity in Human-AI Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2606.04779v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predictive tasks constitute subprocedures within human--AI interactions (HAIs) involving professionals and AI systems. Complementarity occurs when an HAI outperforms a benchmark defined by its constituent agents. Existing formalizations, however, focus on a single human and a single AI, leaving multi-agent interactions insufficiently characterized. We introduce a tree-based mathematical framework for multi-agent complementarity. Ordered agent-role configurations decorate the leaves of rooted planar binary trees and local aggregation rules generate protocol outputs evaluated against either a best-average or a pointwise-min benchmark. We establish four results. First, under linear pooling, every protocol tree provides a bijective coordinate system for the interior of the simplex of global leaf weights. translated_title: 人机交互中多智能体互补性的基于树的形式化
translated_abstract: 预测任务构成了专业人员与人工智能系统之间人机交互（HAI）的子过程。当一个人机交互系统超越由其组成智能体所定义的基准时，就会产生互补性。然而，现有的形式化方法仅关注单个人类与单个AI的情形，对多智能体交互的刻画不足。我们引入了一个基于树的数学框架来研究多智能体互补性。有序的智能体-角色配置被置于有根平面二叉树的叶节点上，局部聚合规则生成协议输出，并对照最佳平均基准或逐点最小基准进行评估。我们建立了四个结果。第一，在线性池化下，每个协议树为全局叶权重单纯形的内部提供了一个双射坐标系。具有相同有序叶节点的任意树都容许保持输出和互补性的重参数化，并通过局部方式实现……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出基于有根平面二叉树的数学框架来形式化多智能体人机交互中的互补性，证明在线性池化下协议树构成全局叶权重单纯形内部的双射坐标系，并建立了保持输出与互补性的树间重参数化等性质。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tree-based mathematical framework for formalizing multi-agent complementarity in human-AI interactions, proving that under linear pooling every protocol tree provides a bijective coordinate system for the interior of the global leaf-weight simplex, along with output- and complementarity-preserving reparameterizations across trees sharing the same ordered leaves.
